goal: Verify that a user can successfully create a new Site Host account, access the main dashboard, and interact with the settings menu to trigger UI updates.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
Once logged into the dashboard, click the settings icon (gear symbol) located in the left sidebar to open the settings menu.
Click the settings icon again to toggle the menu and trigger the UI state change.
success_criteria: The user is successfully redirected from the registration page to the main dashboard view.
The settings menu appears in the top-right area of the dashboard, displaying options like 'Shown time' and 'Order'.
Clicking the settings icon again closes the menu and restores the default calendar view.
The main feed displays existing memo entries (e.g., 'Personal reminder for the weekend') without errors.
